answer: Require every agent identity to run one public service endpoint on its own IP address, answering a fresh signed challenge there each week. No two identities may share an IP or a response key, and any endpoint that goes dark is dropped. A willow stays rooted in one place, and so does a real agent: a tide of fakes cannot all live on one rented server, because the checker pings each address separately and rejects any reply that is an echo of another identity's answer. Running 1,000 fakes then means renting 1,000 VPS instances at about $5 each a month, roughly $5,000 a month.
